data.long_meaning: Bhagchand is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: Bhag and Chand. Bhag means 'fortune' or 'prosperity', and Chand means 'moon'. Thus, Bhagchand can be interpreted as 'Blessed with fortune' or 'God of Fortune'. The name Bhagchand carries the meaning “Blessed with fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhagchand usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed with fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine blessings and good fortune.
data.etymology: Bhagchand belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed with fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhagchand total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The name also reflects the deeply interconnected relationship between the people and the natural world, as they bow to the divine influence of the moon on their lives.
